title: JuStRank: Benchmarking LLM Judges for System Ranking

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the expectation over the differences between an LLM judge's predicted pairwise win-rates for a specific system and the ground-truth human win-rates from Chatbot Arena, corrected for the judge's decisiveness.
Measuring the decisiveness-corrected system-specific bias of an LLM judge specifically towards outputs generated by models that share its own underlying LLM.
